title: Returns
purpose: Find specimens that came back from a shipment and see which still await a manager's review.
summary: Specimens that came back from a shipment, and which still await a manager's review.

tasks.title: Find returns to review
steps: Set [[Review]] to Awaiting review and select [[Apply]].
Managers and administrators: select the row's Review button.

tasks.title: Record a return
steps: Open the shipment and select Record return on the item.

good_to_know: A returned specimen stays on a use hold until a manager releases it for use.
Kept on hold can be reviewed again later.
Thaws reported are as the recipient reported them.

sections.title: What the page shows
paragraphs: Each row is one returned specimen, newest return first. A return is recorded on the shipment page; the specimen comes back on a use hold referring to the shipment until a manager reviews it. It is under the Returns tab of Shipments. Every role can read it. Type in the search box to narrow the rows, use the filters beside it and under More filters, and choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page (25 by default). Active filters appear as chips you can remove one by one; Clear all removes them all. The sort and filters are kept in the address, so a view can be shared. A filter value that is not valid shows no rows rather than all of them. Changing a filter returns you to the first page.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the specimen ID or the shipment number. The default sort is Returned, newest first; Specimen and Shipment can also be sorted.

items.label: Review
items.description: Any review state (the default), Awaiting review (no review yet), Kept on hold (reviewed and kept) or Released for use.

items.label: Specimen
items.description: The specimen ID; opens the specimen. Always shown.

items.label: Review
items.description: Awaiting review, Kept on hold or Released for use.

items.label: Shipment
items.description: Opens the shipment it came back from.

items.label: Amount returned
items.description: The amount measured on return, in the specimen's unit.

items.label: Thaws reported (count)
items.description: As the recipient reported, or Not known.

items.label: Review
items.description: Row button for managers and administrators while the return is not released for use: opens Review return.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Any staff role can download all matching rows across pages as UTF-8 CSV in the selected order. The file uses the current search and filters. Amounts are exact and times use the repository's time zone. If more than 10,000 rows match when the export runs, the download stops. Narrow the filters and try again. Text that starts like a spreadsheet formula gets a leading apostrophe. The audit trail records who downloaded the selection, the filters and the number of data rows in the file. With no matches, the CSV contains only the header and the audit count is zero.
